Adaptive Batch Size Adjustment:
Currently Haddock divides tasks into fixed-sized batches based on available vCPUs for resource-intensive modules like Sampling and Model Refinement. Reducing batch size can mitigate resource contention and improve responsiveness, while increasing batch size during idle periods can maximize throughput. [Applicability]
